inputBindingVerification.method: Read-only Node fs byte-length and SHA256 comparison against every path/sha256 descriptor in input-freeze.json.
inputBindingVerification.nonDisplayInputs: Hash-bound only; source, scientific, figure-semantic, author and native review judgments were not replayed.

scope: Current offline ZH and EN whole-page screenshots at desktop 1440x960 and mobile 390x844.
Visible heading and metadata wrapping, prose and formula fit, figure label fit within the captured viewport, clipping, overlap and coherent section separation.
Static pixel review only, not application acceptance or interaction verification.

observations: Heading, metadata, prose, footnote and terminal control remain inside the centered reading column.
Inline formulas and subscripts are visible with adequate line separation; no text or formula collision or unintended clipping is visible.
The figure, its visible labels and caption fit the desktop reading surface without overlapping adjacent prose; section separators remain distinct.
The heading fits; the longer metadata wraps below it without collision.
Prose, footnote and inline formulas wrap within the reading column with no visible unintended clipping or overlap.
Figure labels and caption are legible and separated from the surrounding prose; the final paragraph and terminal control are fully visible.
The heading fits and metadata wraps within the mobile gutters; prose and footnote maintain coherent line spacing.
Visible inline formulas, arrows, infinity glyphs and subscripts fit the text column without colliding with neighboring lines.

The visible right-edge figure labels and caption are readable and do not overlap the surrounding prose. The left cut at the fixed-width media viewport is intentional horizontal scrolling, not a finding.
Section separators, the final paragraph and terminal control remain visible and separated.
The heading wraps to two lines; multi-line metadata stays below it without overlap or gutter clipping.
Long English prose and the footnote wrap coherently; inline formulas remain visible and do not collide with adjacent text.
The visible right-edge figure labels and caption fit the captured scroll viewport and remain separated from adjacent prose. Off-viewport left-side content is not rejudged as lost content.
The final paragraphs and terminal control are visible with adequate separation.

limits: Four whole-page screenshots were opened once each; none of the four optional figure crops or any source images were opened.
The EN mobile image was displayed by the image tool resized from 390x6276 to 373x6000 pixels; its original saved bytes were hash-verified.

The fixed 640px mobile media shows only the captured horizontal scroll viewport. Existing frozen DOM evidence states scrollEndReachable=true; that evidence was reused without rerunning the checker or independently exercising scrolling.
No SCI/ZH/EN content review, source comparison, fig-05 semantic approval, author check, native finalizer, renderer or DOM checker was replayed.

The verdict covers only these frozen offline pixels at the two supplied viewport sizes; it does not establish application acceptance, other viewport behavior, live interactions or canonical readiness.
